question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched position as paramount leader, with full control over the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and state institutions, underpins trader consensus that he will remain in office through the end of 2026. Loyalists dominate the Politburo and Standing Committee, visible factional challenges are absent, and recent personnel moves plus diplomatic activity signal continuity ahead of the 2027 Party Congress, where a fourth term is widely anticipated. Elite politics remain opaque, yet historical patterns and the lack of public health or political disruptions reinforce stability. Low-probability shifts could still arise from a sudden medical event, severe economic or military crisis prompting elite realignment, or unforeseen internal dynamics before the resolution date.
